integrity: Analytic proof and finite coefficient consistency checks; latter are corroborative only. Primary recent source full text materially compared; earlier Hardy papers were only accessible in limited form. No external independent audit.
scientific_limitations: The result is restricted to positive Dirichlet weights and total-degree-one optimal approximants, and asserts dense location rather than exact attainment. Degree bounds are not quantified. The Hardy endpoint remains unresolved by this proof.
title: Dense diagonal zero locations for weighted bidisk optimal approximants
